entities.summary: Apprenticeship and Free Village Movement, a transformative movement in Jamaica (1834–1865). Emerged from Sam Sharpe's Christmas Rebellion (Baptist War) — December 1831–January 1832 and Emancipation Act — August 1, 1834. Catalyzed Morant Bay Rebellion — October 11, 1865 and Paul Bogle and George William Gordon executed 1865.
